trailhead.label: Ziano di Fiemme (Roda), the APT’s start

cautions: The last stretch down from the Cercenai junction is bare earth and very muddy after rain.
Several small streams to cross in the wood.
Two crossings of the valley cycle path: watch for bikes.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
